title: Build a long sentence with ahora
voice_notes: Warm, patient teacher. One voice. Brian v3. English prompts use language_code en; Spanish reveals use language_code es. Avoid Language Transfer branding.

segments.say: Long Spanish sentences are usually small pieces glued together.
And cancel it is cancelarlo. The lo goes at the end.
First piece: I want to cancel it.
For the negative, Spanish parks no in front.
Second piece: I do not want to cancel it now.
segments.word: I don't want to cancel it now

segments.say: Now glue both pieces with but.
segments.word: I want to cancel it, but I don't want to cancel it now

segments.say: Quiero cancelarlo, pero no quiero cancelarlo ahora.
segments.word: Quiero cancelarlo, pero no quiero cancelarlo ahora
segments.phon: KYE-ro kan-se-LAR-lo, PE-ro no KYE-ro kan-se-LAR-lo a-O-ra

segments.say: Good. That sentence looked big, but nothing inside it was new.

caption: Build a long Spanish sentence from small pieces: quiero cancelarlo, pero no quiero cancelarlo ahora.
